name: com.atthree.wobblefolk.talkmouth
description: Voice-driven mouths for any character: human jaws and blend shapes, monster and beak bones, stylised split heads that hinge open with the voice. Driven by AudioSources, the microphone, voice chat SDKs, typed dialogue or baked clips.

samples.description: Primitive character: sphere head, capsule jaw (Jaw Bone driver) and a mouth that stretches per shape (Transform driver), both following one voice. Keys 1/2/3 switch between a synthetic voice clip, the microphone and typed dialogue; M mutes the mouth.

Stylised head whose top half swings open on a hinge as it talks (Hinge Split driver, Bouncy Split Head profile): two big eyes, a hat that follows a moment later, a lower half that drops a little. Keys 1/2 switch between a synthetic voice and the microphone; B cycles the bounce, J toggles the rattle, M mutes.

Three-eyed primitive monster: lower and upper jaw, two mandibles that spread sideways and a tongue that slides out only when loud, all one Multi Bone driver with the Monster profile. Keys 1/2 switch between a synthetic voice and the microphone; M mutes.

Primitive bird: upper and lower beak halves, crest feathers that follow one after another and wings that flap on loud syllables, all one Multi Bone driver with the Bird profile. Keys 1/2 switch between a synthetic voice and the microphone; M mutes.
